g.text: Photo: Aminucrus, “Early Farming season”, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA
4.0. Resized; the answer version is annotated and shared under CC BY-SA
Many small plots separated by low banks fill the foreground and
middle distance: evidence that the land is cultivated
An unsealed track runs up through the plots from the bottom of
the image, giving access to them.
Some plots hold water or green growth. The image cannot show the
